statusTips.title: Status Guide
statusTips.active: Active — Current ongoing condition that requires attention. Will be prominently shown to the chatbot for health decisions.
statusTips.suspected: Suspected — Preliminary diagnosis that needs confirmation. Chatbot will consider it but with lower certainty.
statusTips.resolved: Resolved — Condition that was treated and is no longer present. Kept for medical history context.
statusTips.history: History — Past condition mentioned in records. Provides background context without implying current relevance.
